(fighter aircraft) component sourcing and PRC-origin critical-minerals risk — defense industrial base framing embedded in the product itself, not just VC-list membership.
score_evidence: 'Expert-informed AI-powered simulations that don't just analyze the past, they stress-test your future' / 'Stochastic risk modeling — Model disruption likelihoods and their operational and financial impact' → lab_language_intensity

'40+ public data sources, Tier-4 trace depth, Minutes to first insights' with zero mention of ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR/STIG anywhere despite mapping fighter-platform ('Platform F-...') and PRC-critical-mineral supply risk → deployment_awareness_absence

'combining operator insight with predictive AI' and 'SME-guided configuration — Align simulation parameters with your real-world operating environment' — 'operator' here means an SME/analyst at a desk, not a warfighter; no CONOPS, training, or field-feedback language anywhere → operator_absence
no jobs data found in pack → hiring_profile_skew set to 10 per instructions

blind_spots.blind_spot: The platform's value proposition rests on ingesting '40+ public data sources' in near-real-time, but the DIB program offices and primes who'd actually consume this risk data (e.g. on an F-series aircraft component) often need it inside an accredited, sometimes air-gapped environment (SIPR-adjacent acquisition systems)
blind_spots.operator_reality: a live public-web-data pipeline built for a browser demo doesn't cross into an accredited enclave without an ATO or a disconnected/periodic-sync mode — nothing on the site addresses how 'minutes to first insights' survives that jump
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: team built the tool as a commercial-facing SaaS demo first; the accreditation path only becomes visible once a government or prime customer tries to actually stand it up
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 40+ public data sources / Tier-4 trace depth / Minutes to first insights

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention of how the platform integrates into existing government acquisition/industrial-base systems (e.g. DIBCAC assessments, PIEE, existing supply-chain-risk tooling primes already use)
blind_spots.operator_reality: a standalone dashboard that isn't wired into the systems a program office or prime already works from becomes shelfware — the 'high-fidelity data ingestion' claim only helps if it can pull from and feed back into those existing back-end systems
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the founding team's DoD pedigree is at the policy/leadership level (SecDef, ASD Readiness), not at the level of day-to-day acquisition-system plumbing
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Seamlessly integrate internal systems, flat files, and external sources for full supply chain integration

blind_spots.blind_spot: The founding team has extraordinary top-cover (a former Secretary of Defense as co-founder) but zero visible bottom-up validation — no named pilot, no case study, no working-level user testimonial
blind_spots.operator_reality: advocacy from the E-ring can open doors, but it can't substitute for a working tool in an analyst's hands; if the door opens before there's a fielded product to show, the funded window to actually deliver starts burning immediately — the classic valley-of-death timing risk for a $5M-$10M company
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: at 3 employees and founded this year, the product is still pre-customer; the site markets the team's credibility rather than a delivered result
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 3 employees; founded 2025; 'When change accelerates and systems fall behind, Vantive turns unpredictability into advantage'

opener_hook: Vantive's homepage groups its own supply-chain risk map by platform down to 'Platform F-...' component sourcing — a fighter-aircraft-specific example worth asking how it maps into an accredited DIB data feed once it needs to run inside a government office.
what_they_do: AI-powered supply-chain risk and provenance-mapping platform, tracing multi-tier supplier and material risk (e.g. critical minerals, aircraft components) for industrial-base decision-makers.
